name: BorgWarner Inc.
old_description: Industrial applications are evolving - and so are we. BorgWarner applies deep engineering expertise and advanced manufacturing capabilities to deliver solutions tailored to today’s industrial performance requirements.
about:
BorgWarner Inc. is headquartered in Hanover Park, Illinois. The company designs and manufactures systems for industrial and automotive applications, applying deep engineering expertise and advanced manufacturing capabilities to deliver solutions tailored to evolving industrial performance requirements.

Its product portfolio centers on battery energy storage systems (BESS), including generator battery systems, uninterruptible power supply units, and turbine generator systems. The company operates a production and service footprint across North America and Europe, with over 5 GWh of production capacity supported by a global supply base for cells and components. Core processes encompass full mechanical, electrical, testing, and validation capabilities, engineering services, and remanufacturing to extend product life. A removable electronics unit (RCB) enables easy service and repair.

BorgWarner serves industrial energy storage markets, providing stationary energy storage based on high-energy NMC battery technology for grid interaction and energy optimization. Customers deploy modular platforms ranging from rack-level backup to multi-megawatt-hour installations, addressing needs from seconds to hours of discharge duration.

The company differentiates itself through a cell-agnostic hardware and software architecture, automotive-grade battery management with redundant safety architecture, and a common hardware foundation that enables rapid deployment across power and energy scales.
